learning_objective: 🎯 Step through the looking glass into the world below zero, where numbers go in reverse to help us measure cold temperatures and deep basements!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: What happens when you count down past 1? You hit zero! But the numbers do not stop there. They keep going into the negatives, like -1, -2, and -3. We use negative numbers for freezing weather and owing money.

Imagine a long straight path. Zero is sitting right in the middle. Positive numbers march off to the right, getting bigger and bigger. Negative numbers march off to the left, getting smaller and smaller!
Every positive number has an evil twin! The number 5 is exactly five steps to the right of zero, and -5 is exactly five steps to the left. They are total opposites.

fun_activity.title: 🏢 The Elevator Game
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a tall building with floors going up to 5 and basement levels going down to -3. Pretend you are on floor 2 and ride the elevator down 4 floors. What negative floor did you end up on?

quick_recap: ⭐ Integers include all positive whole numbers, all negative whole numbers, and zero.
⭐ Zero is super neutral; it is neither positive nor negative!
⭐ On a number line, any number on the right is always larger than any number on the left.
